options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enables or disables WireGuard on this system. WireGuard cannot be disabled when one or more tunnels is assigned to a pfSense interface.

options.name: hide_peers
options.description: Enables or disables initially hiding all peers in the user interface.

options.name: hide_secrets
options.description: Enables or disables hiding all secrets (private and pre-shared keys) in the user interface.

options.name: interface_group
options.description: Configures which WireGuard tunnels are members of the WireGuard interface group.

options.name: keep_conf
options.description: Enables or disables keeping the WireGuard configuration when the package is uninstalled/reinstalled.

options.name: resolve_interval
options.description: The interval (in seconds) for re-resolving endpoint host/domain names.

options.name: resolve_interval_track
options.description: Enables or disables tracking the 'Aliases Hostnames Resolve Interval' value as the `resolve_internal` value instead of specifying a value directly.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
